fixes.value: Decision flow chart for asbestos work. Loose asbestos, coating, lagging, badly damaged AIB or insulation needs an HSE-licensed contractor; AIB or insulation in good condition needs a licensed contractor if one person works on it for more than one hour in a week, or two or more workers for more than two hours in total, start to finish, in a week. Otherwise, and for asbestos cement, textured coatings and articles such as gaskets, textiles and floor tiles, the task is not licensed and you then ask whether it is notifiable non-licensed work (NNLW). Removal of highly friable or poorly bonded material, or material in poor condition, is NNLW: notify the enforcing authority, keep a record of the job and make sure all workers have had a medical examination (from April 2015). Maintenance or removal of non-friable material in good condition, encapsulation, air monitoring and sampling are non-licensed work: use the right task sheet and equipment sheets and keep the number of people present low.

fixes.target: figure-p7: Where asbestos materials can be found in a residential property
fixes.value: Cut-away drawing of a house with 21 numbered places where asbestos can be found, and a key. Usually licensed: pipe lagging, loose fill insulation, AIB airing cupboard and/or sprayed insulation coating on boiler and hot water tank, AIB soffits. Normally non-licensed: asbestos cement water tank, toilet seat and cistern, vinyl floor tiles, textured decorative coating, roofing felt, asbestos cement panels, soffits, roof, gutters and downpipes. Non-licensed if short duration, otherwise licensed: AIB ceiling tiles, bath panel, behind fuse box, partition wall, interior and exterior window panels, behind fire, and around boilers, storage heaters and warm air heating. A note says the drawing does not show every use and a survey is needed to find all asbestos.

fixes.target: figure-p8: Where asbestos materials can be found in an industrial property
fixes.value: Cut-away drawing of an industrial building with 19 numbered places where asbestos can be found, and a key. Usually licensed: sprayed coatings on ceilings, walls, beams and columns, loose fill insulation, lagging on boilers and pipes, AIB soffits. Normally non-licensed: asbestos cement water tank, toilet seat and cistern, rope seals, gaskets and paper, vinyl floor tiles, textiles such as fire blankets, textured decorative coating, and asbestos cement roof, panels, gutters and downpipes, soffits and flue. Non-licensed if short duration, otherwise licensed: AIB ceiling tiles, partition walls, panels in fire doors, and AIB around boilers, storage heaters and warm air heating. A note says the drawing does not show every use and a survey is needed to find all asbestos.
